## **In-Game Bonuses**
 - Build Rate: 10% per level
 - Critter Gain: 5% per level
 - Soul Gain: 5% per level
 - Total DMG: 15% per level
 - All Kills: 1% per level
 - XP Multi: 4% per level
 - Atom Cost: -1.5% per level
https://i.imgur.com/EIEZg2q.png

## **Mega Flesh Reset**
### - The Main, and only, reset in Bubba

### - Semi-Rated: Red-Orange-Yellow-Green-Black (Red Bad, Green Good, Black is Bonus Boosting)
 - 💛 MF1: Nice stacking bonus to meat produced, but we get it so early and its very basic, so its just like part of the base clicker essentially
 - 🖤 MF2: Boosts Bonuses by 1.2x
 - 💚 MF3: Great bonus, Beeg Slice feels required to have, and this lets us bring in some of the other great Gifts
 - 🖤 MF4: Boosts Bonuses by 1.4x
 - 💚 MF5: +1 Dice is insanely good for scaling dice, extra sides is useful, but dont scale very good, and "Worser Rolls are ignored" is great
 - 💚 MF6: Really good, one of the best bonuses, 3x boost a selected Charisma bonus, very powerful, this opens new strategies such as boosting Joy, doing a double pat, swapping to Hustle, gift spamming, then swapping to Rizz and doing your MF reset
 - 🖤 MF7: Boosts Bonuses by 1.6x 
 - ❤️ MF8: +50 Bubba Pats at the start
 - 💚  MF9: Very OP, 75% chance to get a free meat when upgrading smoker, this means you get the meat, but smoker time doesnt reset, and cost doesnt increase, essentially meaning 4x the smoked meat statistically, which is crazy.
 - 🖤 MF10: Boosts Bonuses by 1.8x
https://i.imgur.com/vyKBpxc.png

## **Gifts**
### - Obtained from 'Fun Gifts," the 10th upgrade, and persists through Mega Flesh Resets, letting you bring 1 (then 2) powerful bonuses into your run, these are picked at the start of a run, or right after a Mega Flesh reset, and cannot be changed until you do another Mega Flesh reset
 - Gift 1: Required in every run (might change with time skips), you do Double Pats for huge Happiness multipliers and gift spam to generate very large gains
 - Gift 2: Sucks, only used in MF3 when that's the 2nd gift you have after getting the ability to use 2 gifts
 - Gift 3: the staple of MF4 through MF7, extremely useful in getting the tons of Charisma levels we need
 - Gift 4: Seemingly not useful, goes in with Gift 2, we probably wont ever use it
 - Gift 5: Great way to boost Smoker, after unlocking this we typically use it instead of Gift 3
etc...?
https://i.imgur.com/lsAnGrL.png

## **Happiness**
## - 2nd Upgrade, unlocks your 1st tab at the top! This shows your Happiness Tier with a multiplier to base income
 - Happiness is received from 1 of 3 sources
   - Happi Boi: Pat Bubba to receive Happiness, details on the amount of Happiness you get are in the upgrade
   - Buyer Grin: Gives Happiness every time you buy an upgrade
   - Beach Ball (Gift 3): Gives +200 Happiness when buying the upgrade "Open Gift"
 - Happiness is not a direct multiplier, in the sense that if your Happi Boi upgrade says you get +10 Happiness from patting Bubba 1 time, you will not get a 10x or 11x multiplier
 - Happiness falls back down to 0 over time, starting instantly after gaining Happiness
 - Happiness falls quicker the larger it is
 - Happiness Tiers:
   - Amused: 1x - 10.1x
   - Beaming: 10.1x - 21.2x
   - Contented: 21.2x - 51x
   - Delighted: 51x - 140.7x
   - Ecstatic: 140.7x+
 - Happi Boi Level for each Pat:
```
3 Pats: Lvl 1
4 Pats: Lvl 3
5 Pats: Lvl 4
6 Pats: Lvl 6

9 Pats: Lvl 34

```
https://i.imgur.com/ja9mfLp.png

## **Charisma**
### - 7th upgrade, unlocks a new tab at the top portion of Bubba, you can select 1 of 6 bonuses that will level up over time. If you buy Charisma and dont have a bonus selected, it will continue to generate levels, and store them internally, and once you select a bonus, all those levels will be applied, this is something to be careful of, as you don't want to accidentally over level a bonus. This also works if a bonus is max level and you have it selected, Charisma will internally store any levels gained for when you select a new bonus to upgrade
 - The time required to get a level increases reasonably fast, and thus it is the first main Time-Wall upgrade in Bubba, but its quite useful, following different strategies for each Mega Flesh reset
 - Remember not to use time skip items without thinking about your charisma bonuses, make sure to select the proper bonus as to not waste levels by overleveling a category, such as joy
 - The bonuses are as follows (per level):
```
Hustle: +0.1x Meat Generation
Rizz: 1-(1/(1+0.02x)) Cost Reduction
Joy: +0.05x Happiness from all sources
Courage: +1% Dice luck
Mindful: 10 levels for +1% chance for 2x LVs gained when buying an upgrade instead of 1 level like normal
Savvy: +1% Coins
```
 - **Mindful does NOT work on these upgrades: Bubba Boon, MF, Fun Gifts, Open Gift, Dice Roll, More Dice, Smoker, More Sides**
https://i.imgur.com/lGOwoC2.png

## **Dice**
### - 13th upgrade, provides a multiplier to base meat generation based upon the values of your roll(s)
 - The formula for the multiplier received is as follows:
```
1+((Dice Value * Dice Value *...)/100)
```
 - With 1 dice, this means whatever you roll, is your bonus as a %, so a 6 is a 6% increase, or a 1.06x multiplier
  - At 2 dice, your values are multiplied with one another, so if you have 2 6's, you take 6 times 6, which is 36, for a 1.36x multiplier
 - After MF5 you get your first bonus to quantity of faces on your dice, which takes it to 11, but any value past a 6 is worth less than what is displayed, they work as so;
```

2 = 2

18 = 10.8

20 = 11.6
```
https://i.imgur.com/QxbKCxX.png

## **Smoker**
### - 16th upgrade, allows you to get Smoked Meat, which provide a bonus based upon their type of meat (5 types)
 -  Once you purchase smoker, your timer is reset to 0 seconds, and you receive a smoked meat
 - Smoker has a timer, same as Charisma, except Charisma starts once you buy it, the Smoker starts counting from the beginning of your run after you pick your gifts, this causes your time, the first time you unlock it, to appear large, but also give you an idea on how long it took you to reach it, which is cool
 - Smoker has 5 tiers of meat, each tier of meat provides a bonus to your production, and they multiply with each other (see image)
 - The tier of meat you get is determined by several factors, simplified down to basic RNG, and time spent smoking the meat before purchasing it
      - **Check Each MF Guide to see more details about how long to smoke your meat for whatever MF you are in**
 - You can use the chart below to try to stay on target for optimized meats
https://i.imgur.com/Gg9kLCX.png

## **Coins**
 - Seems Coins are not multiplicative with one another like Dice and Smoker have been
 - Each coin provides a bonus equal to its actual value
   - Penny: +0.01x
   - Nickel: +0.05x
   - Quarter: +0.25x
   - Dollar: +1.00x
Image

## **General Rules**


 - ⚠️ **DON'T open gifts until the VERY END of your run**⚠️
 - ⚠️  **Bubba is easy to mess up and time "lock" yourself, if this happens, try your best to escape and then pick up on the guide whenever possible**⚠️
 - ⚠️ **Read each step of your MF carefully before doing ANYTHING**⚠️
 - When I say "MF3" that means you are in MF3, you're Mega Flesh upgrade is lvl 3, and you have 3 Mega Flesh bonuses, you are working on buying your 4th
 - When using Time Skips, be efficient with them, this means upgrading inbetween uses, feel free to save up for a more expensive upgrade over multiple skips, but dont just spam 20 skips in a row to "get more meat," upgrade things in between to boost base generation (Note that time skips reset happiness)
 -  Charisma is very important, a fair bit of the guide is Charisma early on
 -  "Double Pat" refers to when you save your pats until your hourly reset timer is at 2-3 seconds, quickly do all your pats, let timer reset, and then do all your pats again, this provides an even bigger happiness multiplier for opening gifts
 - Read about each Feature above
 - Buy Bargain until its cost per level is greater than the decrease in cost of your next Mega Flesh Reset from that same level, in such that if Bargain costs 100 meat, and decreases cost by 110, buy it, but once it costs 105 meat and only decreases Mega Flesh by 104 meat, stop
 -  **Before Gifts, do some calculations first to see if you're ready:**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iEBqFKfsIsVkM_-6hO9j7uIdtrRHuT4UN93xmmeI9Eo/edit?usp=sharing

**MF1 and MF2**
```
Not hard, just push as far as you can, and open a few gifts after doing a Double pat if you can/need to
Make sure to buy Fun Gift 2 before buying MF3
```

**MF3**
```
1. Pick Gift 1 and 2

2. Remember from Mega Flesh 1, you now get a meat multiplier based upon total levels, which is the reasoning behind the cost ratios (leveling everything) mentioned at step 5 and onwards

3. Play the game normally, just push upgrades and bonuses overtime

4. At Charisma unlock get Hustle to lvl 30-40, swap to Rizz and get lvl 30-40, then get Joy to lvl 10, then swap back and forth between Hustle and Rizz, keep them at similar levels

5. Try to maintain a cost ratio of 2:5 between 1st Slice/Good Meat and 2nd Slice/Great Meat

6. Keep Happi Boi and Buyer Grin to slightly below the cost of 1st slice and Good Meat

7. Keep Charisma similar cost to 1st Slice and Good Meat, maybe even slightly more expensive early on (To boost Charisma level gains)

8. Remember to buy Bargain until it costs more for 1 level than the sum of MF4 and gift 3 decreases from that 1 level

9. Push until you can buy both Fun Gift level 3 and MF4 by doing your gift push (Can use the Optimizer in pins)

10. Double Pat --> Open gifts --> Buy Fun Gift 3 --> Buy MF4
```
https://i.imgur.com/pTuvth9.png

**MF4**
```
1. Pick Gift 1/3

2. Charisma: Max Hustle, grab lvl 27 Joy, then sit on Rizz until you finish (Feel free to grab some rizz before either Max Hustle or 27 Joy, as these are goals for the end of MF4, but dont wait too long to level these 2)

3. Similar Cost Strategy to MF3, but now that you have Gift 3, Charisma is even more important, do not neglect the Charisma upgrade to make it slightly faster, and keep Super Chart at around 5-10x the cost of 2nd Slice/Great Meat

4. You will mainly be waiting on Charisma levels, and step 5, just push naturally, following the Cost strategy, until you hit the previously stated Charisma level goals, and complete step 5 (next step)

5. Push for 2983B total meat to unlock "More Dice" and get 1 level in it

6. Start rolling dice until you get a decent roll, I settled with 1.20x, which was a 4 and a 5

7. Push until you can buy MF5 (Use the Optimizer)

8. WAIT, Select Rizz in Charisma as opening a gift with Numbahs (Gift 3) will get +1 level to whatever bonus you have selected

9. Double Pat --> Open about 10 Gifts --> Buy MF5
```
https://i.imgur.com/GKuqyCe.png

**MF5**
```
1. Pick Gift 1/3

2. Now with MF5, roll 1 time every hourly reset (there is currently a bug with dice)

4. Charisma: 120/120/50/0/0/0 (This is the Chart in order from Hustle to Savvy, so 120 Hustle, and 0 savvy)

6. Similar price ratios, with a small adjustment. Follow the same ratios as before until costs are up to around 10B's to 100B's, then let Charisma's cost drop slightly as it's levels start to become a little less effective, this is also due to a new "Time Wall" later on

7. Get More Dice lvl 1 again, now you have 3 dice instead of just 2, a max roll at this point is 6.12x, continue to roll 1 time each hour

8. Go back to natural pushing and use the previously mentioned cost ratios as rough guidelines to keep everything leveled equally and somewhat efficiently, this is to take benefit of Glazed Ham from MF1 of course

9. By now you should be nearing Smoker, look at the index for "Smoker" for lots of more specific details regarding it, and you can probably start rolling dice 2 times each hourly reset

10. In Smoker you want to aim to build up about 27-30 Meats Smoked, this is a very long wait, roughly 12 hours is a good smoke time per meat (Feel free to use Time Skips)

11. Push until you can buy MF6 (Gift 4 is not worth pushing for) (Use the Optimizer)

12. Aim for about 30B+ base income

13. WAIT, Select Rizz in Charisma as opening a gift with Numbahs will give +1 level, this lets you go past the max lvl of 120 in Rizz

14. Double Pat --> Open about 14 or 15 Gifts --> Buy MF6
```
https://i.imgur.com/2XJdRvu.jpeg

**MF6**
```
1. Pick Gift 1/3

2. MF6 is very useful, check the MF Index for Strategies, you should be swapping between Joy, Rizz, and Hustle depending on what you're doing that moment

3. Buy minimal upgrades until Charisma, then read Step 5

4. Due to the bonus from unlocking MF6, completing this Mega Flesh Reset is almost identical to MF5, so refer to MF5 until you get caught up to the end of it (Unlock Smoker)

5. Charisma: 57/80/23/0/120/0 (Mindful is always first, then a little Hustle, then Rizz, then between Hustle and Joy, but you wanna make sure you get Joy 23, then all extra levels past these listed go into hustle, still open gifts on Rizz)

6. MINDFUL DOES NOT WORK ON THESE UPGRADES: Bubba Boon, MF, Fun Gifts, Open Gift, Dice Roll, More Dice, Smoker, More Sides

7. Now with Emulsify, always Emulsify Mindful when buying upgrades, until it takes several hours to buy an upgrade, then go back to Rizz if you want

8. Smoker: 12 hour smokes per meat

9. Continue to push Smoker and other upgrades until you get around More Dice lvl 2, I recommend saving all meat when you reach 100B-200B base income, can do it sooner, and it will take roughly 30 hours to get More Dice lvl 2 (dependent on base income and cost reduction), it is very worth it

10. Continue rolling Dice for a good roll, you should be able to afford 2-3 rolls per hourly reset

11. Aim for roughly 600B-700B+ base income (Emulsified) and then verify with the calculator 

12. -->EXTREMELY IMPORTANT<-- So, you're about to do your gift push for MF7? Read this step in its entirety before doing ANYTHING and follow it very specifically: Emulsify Joy, Double Pat, Emulsify Hustle, SINGLE CLICK Rizz, as to make sure we level it up with gift usage, Keep Hustle Emulsified though! Now after doing all of this as quick as you can, as to not lose Happiness, open about 19 or 20 gifts (check calculator)

13. Emulsify Swap Tech --> Open about 19-20 Gifts --> Emulsify Rizz --> Buy MF7
```
https://i.imgur.com/w6N3cH4.png

**MF7**
```
1. Pick Gift 1/3 as gift 4 isn't useful

2. Charisma: 83/100/27/0/120/0

3. Try to get to Super Chart in as few upgrades as you can manage, this boosts Mindful for when you buy upgrades (Read MF6 Step 6)

4. You should be starting to get the hang of what's going on at the beginning by now, push up to Smoker, roll dice and get levels in "More Dice" as you go

5. Smoker: 12 Hour Smokes, took me 80 hours to get to Smoker

6. Continue pushing Smoker, get More Dice lvl 2, and roll for a good roll, you're gonna need it

7. Unlock Uber Gifts and grab a couple levels, follow the optimizer to be more efficient with upgrades

8. Work towards Cost Saver (Unlocks at 86Q), and when you get close, 60-70Q or so, start stockpiling meat, only upgrading Smoker, then level Cost Saver a bunch, and check back on the optimizer to see what to push

9. We wanna buy Gift 5 here as well, its better than Numbahs, so we need to go past what the optimizer says

10. I found myself getting Best Meat, the upgrade after Cost Saver

11. 50-70T Base Income? (WIP Estimate)

12. Emulsify Swap Tech --> Open About 23-25 Gifts --> Emsulfiy Rizz --> Buy Gift 5 --> Buy MF8
```
https://i.imgur.com/pd5WkFk.png

**MF8**
```
1. Pick Gift 1/5

2. Charisma: 75/100/30/0/120/0

3. Smoker: 10 Hour Smokes, use the "Smoker" Guide to see if you can, and want, to try and fix potential ratio issues between meat tiers

4. Same as previously, get Mindful and Super Chart in as few upgrades as possible first things first

5. Odds are very low, but technically it's possible to get 12 pats, if you want to attempt this, dont buy any levels in Happi Boi until you have Super Chart as high as possible, likely towards the end of your run, maybe around lvl 40-50+, with that said, it's unlikely you'll get 12 pats, but feel free to try if you truly want to

6. You know how to play Bubba so far, just keep to normal, but this time around you are, hopefully, getting TONS of smoked meats, and remember both Super Chart and Uber Gifts are very good upgrades to boost our mindful and smoked meats

7. Keep pushing until Best Meat, which is after Cost Saver

8. Dump into Best Meat, and keep mass upgrading the big upgrades, Super Chart, Uber Gift, and Cost Saver, while following the optimizer as you feel needed.

9. I got lucky with gift 5, but more than likely you'll need to keep pushing for a bit

10. Goal is to get More Dice lvl 3 in 1-3 gifts, then roll for a good roll, and ideally get a roughly 6x increase to generation, maybe more.

11. Due to things such as Mindful, and if you level Rizz differently, I'll provide a large range of recommended income to get MF9, and then provide another range for Gift 6, if you want to try and get it

12. MF9: 750T-3Q Income

13. Gift 6: 10Q-20Q Income

14. Obviously, either check optimizer, or do your own math to check

16. Emulsify Swap Tech --> Open Gifts --> Emulsify Rizz --> Buy Gift 6 (Optional) --> Buy MF9
```
https://i.imgur.com/DO38vig.png

**MF9 (Work in Progress)**
```
1. Gift 1/5

2. Charisma: 63/76/1/0/120/35

3. Smoker: Same as last time

4. New Strat: Dont Pat Bubba at all anymore, aside from 10-20 times when doing your small Gift opening for More Dice lvl 3

5. I'm choosig to not level Buyer Grin AT ALL, and try to limit upgrades in 1st slice and Happi Boi, I will keep it that way until I get coins, feel free to try this in a way you think is best, its all experimenting at the moment

6. Aside from that, follow previous strats regarding mindful, and you should know mostly what to do for awhile

7. Now, back to upgrading Happi Boi, this is only done if you decide to gift for More Dice Lvl 3, which I did, you can try to do it in 3 gifts or so, whatever you feel, and if you do, youll level happi boi a bit, then ignore it after you get a 5th dice.

8. Either way, get a 5th dice

9. Now roll until you have a good multiplier, keep doing Smoker, thanks to MF9 Smoker is a huge bonus

10. with a 5th dice and a good Smoker, you want to push for Coins, remember to not over upgrade anything, since Coins are earned only when buying upgrades

11. Unlock Coins, Spam buy all your upgrades now, particularly the ones you were holding out on

12. 300Q - 1QQ Base Income



13. --> FROM NOW ON <-- You probably only get 1-5 lvls in Joy, if you did that, do Emulsify Swap Tech, if you didnt, then you literally just boost Hustle for gifts, and Rizz for MF reset

14. ----> NEW TECH <---- Buy Smoker until its cost is somewhat high, as opposed to it being super cheap, like normal, since we wait for it to build up time. right at the end portion of your run, you buy the crap out of it, all at 0 seconds, just spam it. I got about 8x gains easily
```
